title: HAZOP procedure
note: DRAFT. Written as a starting point for a client discipline engineer to confirm or change (W5b-10, #547). The source standards are not held, so no clause number below has been checked against the standard's text; each is the author's reading of its table of contents. Nothing here is a finding until a signed-off playbook says so.

elements.title: Scope and objectives of the study
elements.expects: The procedure says what a HAZOP study covers and what it is for.

elements.title: Team and roles
elements.expects: The procedure names the study leader, the scribe and the discipline members.

elements.title: Preparation and input documents
elements.expects: The procedure lists what must be ready before the study (P&IDs, data).

elements.title: Division of the plant into nodes
elements.expects: The procedure says how the plant is divided into nodes or study parts.

elements.title: Guidewords and deviations
elements.expects: The procedure uses guidewords to generate deviations.

elements.title: Causes, consequences and safeguards
elements.expects: Each deviation is analysed for causes, consequences and existing safeguards.

elements.title: Risk ranking method
elements.expects: The procedure states how risk is ranked (severity and likelihood, a matrix).

elements.title: Worksheet fields
elements.expects: The study worksheet is described with its columns (node, deviation, cause, consequence, safeguards, action).

elements.title: Recommendations and their follow-up
elements.expects: Recommendations get an owner and a due date and are tracked to closure.

elements.title: Report and records
elements.expects: The procedure says what report is issued and what records are kept.

elements.title: Revalidation and management of change
elements.expects: The procedure says when the study is repeated or reviewed (periodic, after a change).
